strategy: Three-way source replay relative to the verified v0.8.6 baseline; review each LuaSlice conflict against the target architecture. Not a blanket ours/theirs merge.
rulings: Native worktree request did not return; reconciled Git worktree list, canceled the waiting request and used a separate Git worktree. No original checkout/index changes.
The original repository was shallow at v0.8.6/v0.8.7. Deepened the fixed baseline by 800 commits instead of allowing unrelated histories. Verified common ancestor matches GitHub.
Use v0.8.6 as semantic replay base because a historical merge conflates 547 mainline changes with LuaSlice modifications; preserve both histories at the eventual integration checkpoint.
Keep LuaSlice build number 102 and me.luaslice identity; target build number 70 must not downgrade Android metadata.
Keep mobile Chart/Animation Editor flags; Camera Editor starts with target desktop policy until mobile validation, since it was not an existing mobile feature.
Move test save isolation before bootstrap Save.load and mod selection into the native preloader. Do not reload mods or initialize Discord again in Main/InitState.
Use target task-based registries, typed asset paths and Context3DBlendTarget render batching; retain official legacy path aliases and LuaSlice-specific shader files.
Preserve editor audio/freeplay panels as separate toolboxes; the target Timing toolbox does not replace them. Combine target preferences with LuaSlice-specific controls.
Preserve existing enabledMods storage through legacy directory-to-metadata-ID conversion, retaining order and disabled-mod policy.

HMM completed but left several already-installed repositories at default revisions. Explicitly checked out all pinned manifest revisions in the independent migration .haxelib and verified every Git dependency HEAD.

Stock and old Lime native binaries lack the preview's five-argument alert primitive. Rebuilding the pinned native library is required; temporary bootstrap binaries are not release-verified runtime libraries.

Recursive Lime dependency initialization encountered an empty optional SDL_image/aom checkout. All top-level pinned modules and required external/libwebp were initialized separately; pinned Windows native release/debug libraries now rebuild successfully.

Haxe 4.3.7 gencpp.ml lines 6540-6553 generates every static-method wrapper when any reflective function remains, including unreflective native-pointer callbacks. Verified against the pinned compiler source, a failing native callback regression, and a passing public-alias/private-implementation probe. Keep normal reflection and original native class names while excluding internal bridge implementations from CPPIA subclass generation; do not disable scriptable globally. Explicit Polymod import aliases preserve the script-visible names. This compatibility adjustment does not constitute the requested Psych API reimplementation.

The full native retry passed LuaRuntime.cpp but stopped on hxluajit-wrapper LuaConverter.cpp. Add the native hxluajit package to the existing targeted Polymod subclass exclusions rather than editing the pinned dependency. Real table conversion and Lua function invocation pass in the native regression after this change.
